summary_en: INX-315, an oral CDK2 inhibitor, is being tested in adults with advanced or metastatic cancer, including hormone receptor positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that progressed after a CDK4/6 inhibitor, and CCNE1-amplified solid tumors such as ovarian cancer. INX-315 is taken by mouth, alone or with fulvestrant (given as an injection into muscle) or abemaciclib (taken by mouth); how long or how often is not stated. This Phase 1/2 study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary antitumor activity.
summary_es: INX-315, un inhibidor oral de CDK2, se está probando en adultos con cáncer avanzado o metastásico, incluido cáncer de mama con receptores hormonales positivos y HER2 negativo que progresó después de un inhibidor de CDK4/6, y tumores sólidos con amplificación de CCNE1, como el cáncer de ovario. INX-315 se toma por vía oral, solo o con fulvestrant (administrado como inyección intramuscular) o abemaciclib (por vía oral); la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. Este estudio de fase 1/2 mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral preliminar.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer that progressed after a CDK4/6 inhibitor
Platinum-resistant or platinum-refractory high grade serous ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer with CCNE1 amplification that progressed after standar
Advanced solid tumor with CCNE1 amplification that progressed after standard therapy or where standard therapy was not tolerated or not suitable
At least one measurable lesion that has not been irradiated
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and adequate blood, kidney, and liver test results
not_for: Previous treatment with a CDK2, CDK4/6, or CDK2/4/6 inhibitor
Brain metastases or spinal cord compression with progressive symptoms or a need for steroids
Resting QTcF above 470 msec or a history of prolonged QT syndrome
Other cancer history (with listed exceptions), HIV, or active uncontrolled infection, including hepatitis B or C
